text:
alex: Quick heads-up — EMEA premium requests are being routed to us-west during recent load spikes; seeing p95 ~650ms for some tenants and SLO alerts firing.

maria: Yikes. Are those coming from the smart-routing probe decisions? We expected eu-west affinity for EMEA tenants.

alex: Looks like the region_affinity score considered eu region 'unhealthy' because our probe timeout (1s) missed intermittent responses. The scoring then picked nearest healthy (us-west).

samir: We should prefer Dedicated pools for premium customers instead of falling back to hosted automatically. Current chain is: region_affinity -> availability -> nearest. Pool priority isn't tier-aware.

ben: Proposed quick change (config idea):

```
routing_policy:
  - match: customer_tier == "premium"
    prefer: [dedicated_in_region, hosted_in_region, hosted_nearest]
    probe_timeout_ms: 300
  - match: customer_tier == "standard"
    prefer: [hosted_in_region, hosted_nearest]
    probe_timeout_ms: 500
fallback_model_variants:
  preferred: base_fp16
  fallback: [q8_0, q4_0]
```

maria: 300ms probe_timeout is aggressive on noisy links; okay for premium if we also push better telemetry so ops can see false negatives. Maybe 400ms compromise.

alex: Also we need richer telemetry (route_reason codes). Per-request route decision logs with: request_id, customer_id_hash, route_decision, reason_code (probe_timeout | capacity_shortage | config_tag), and chosen_model_variant. No raw prompts logged.

ops-bot: Note: we must be careful with customer privacy. Hashing customer_id is fine but avoid exporting to external analytics without consent.

samir: Important: when falling back to a quantized model variant for latency, we must gate that for premium customers. Run async quality checks (small prompt set) and mark variant as degraded if regression > threshold; then skip variant in routing.

ben: Console UX idea: per-customer route histogram (region/pool/variant) + an alert when >X% of premium requests are routed out-of-region or to lower-quality variants. Also an enterprise toggle: "prefer dedicated (contract)" that overrides auto-fallback.

maria: Rate-limit interaction: if dedicated pool capacity exhausted, do NOT silently fall back to hosted for premium unless contract allows — surface a decision to the console and create an incident or send an ops notification.

alex: Short-term plan: patch probe_timeout for premium to 400ms, add route_decision logs, and roll canary to 5% in eu region. Add dashboard panels: route_reason distribution + variant downgrade counts.

samir: I'll open a PR with the routing config change + metrics emission (route_reason tag). Will include migration notes for the config store.

ben: Also add a small hook in the runtime that tags requests with chosen_variant_quality_score from the offline monitor, so we can trend quality vs latency.

maria: Runbook update needed: add steps for cross-region routing incidents and a one-click rollback for routing-policy.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for routing-policy v2 -> 5% of eu requests.

deploy-bot: Canary 5% completed, no errors in 3m window.

alex: Solid. Once samir's PR is up I'll review and we can expand the canary. Thanks all.

samir: PR: https://git.internal/repo/PR/4827 (will add tests for route_reason emission).

alex: Thanks — ping me if you need dedicated pool mapping access.

ben: +1 :thumbsup:

maria: Adding TODO to update dashboard panels and runbook.

alex: Closing this thread; tracking via PR/board card.
